notes.title: Major Update – Complete Overhaul with Unreal Engine 5
notes.content:
[b][h2]Content of the Update:[/h2][/b]

[list]
[*][b]Upgrade to Unreal Engine 5:[/b] A major technological leap that improves graphics, lighting, and game performance. Enjoy a smoother and more immersive experience.
[*][b]Complete User Interface Overhaul:[/b] A clearer and more intuitive design for easier navigation.
[/list]

[b][h3]New Features:[/h3][/b]

[list]
[*][b]New Melee Weapon:[/b] The baseball bat! Can be used for close combat attacks, with endurance management and the option to block.
[*][b]Push Action:[/b] Push zombies or other characters with any equipped weapon.
[*][b]New Animation for the ZAR-1:[/b] More fluidity and realism in the weapon's movements.
[*][b]New Zombie Movement Animation:[/b] More natural and impactful movements for a better experience.
[*][b]Bandage Application Animation Added:[/b] Apply your bandages with a new immersive animation.
[/list]

[b][h3]Improvements:[/h3][/b]

[list]
[*][b]Locker Overhaul:[/b] Improved organization and management of stored items.
[*][b]Shop Overhaul:[/b] You can now purchase weapons. Price adjustments and changes to the sale of resources (now selling for 50 units instead of 100).
[*][b]Loot System Modified:[/b] Improved distribution of lootable items, with adjustments to the frequency and variety of found items.
[/list]

[b][h3]New Content:[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Added NPC Gabriel Nozak:[/b] A new key character who will give you interesting quests to enrich your adventure.
[*][b]First Quest Given by Gabriel Nozak:[/b] Embark on the quest offered by this character to begin an exciting series of missions.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.0.1.5
notes.content:
[b][u]General[/u][/b]

[b]Additions:[/b]

[list]
[*]Storage locker to organize your items.
[*]2K resolution support on certain objects for improved visual quality.
[*]New handgun: P9.
[*]Key point markers added to the colony for easier exploration.
[*]Escape button functionality to close HUD windows (loot, shop, inventory).
[*]The loot button now disappears after picking up an item.
[*]Click sound added to HUD menus for the shop and storage locker.
[/list]

[b]Improvements:[/b]

[list]
[*] New 3D model for the ZAR-1 weapon.
[*] Adjusted footstep volume based on movement speed.
[/list]

[b]Fixes:[/b]

[list]
[*] The EULA (End-User License Agreement) no longer remains displayed after being accepted.
[/list]

[u][b]Player[/b][/u]

[b]Additions:[/b]

[list]
[*] Stamina system for more realistic physical effort management.
[*] Added missing footstep sounds for certain animations.
[/list]

[b]Improvements:[/b]

[list]
[*] Footstep sound range reduced by 50% for increased stealth.
[/list]

[u][b]Zombies[/b][/u]

[b]Balance Adjustments:[/b]

[list]
[*] Reduced zombie attack range.
[*] Lowered zombie damage from 20 to 15.
[/list]

[b]Improvements:[/b]

[list]
[*] Partial rework of the attack system for better realism.
[/list]
